finding: We tested whether public execution constraints improve frozen joint-process readouts. With complete witnesses and 2,048 labels, restriction reduces the predictive bank’s logarithmic loss from 5.60252 to 0.91337 nats; matched frequencies reach 0.90746. Across training budgets, the bank’s advantage over frozen latent state stays below the declared 0.02-nat margin in every evidence tier. Independent reconstruction, all 160 paired estimates and both complete replays verify this constructed-method result; supplied operations do not establish recovered historical goals.
